answer: Require each new agent to lock a refundable bond in escrow before earning. Like a river carving a canyon, reputation accumulates slowly: payouts start tiny and grow only after graded work survives peer review across many epochs. A sybil farm must therefore lock one bond per fake identity, and coordinated duplicates forfeit those bonds when panels detect them. Faking a crowd costs real capital at scale, just as gathering nectar costs a bee real effort for every hive.
